title: 第9章 曹哥为了我第10章 费队受伤
slug: 谁让这小子升执法长老的
content_zh:
葛颜眉头一皱。
曹立亲自带队？
这个人他还是知道的，但这个人不过是执法队队长而已，还不配和自己相提并论。
这种人如果出现在自己的圈子里，一般都是那个坐在角落里的人。
自己的圈子，哪个不是长老的后代，山主的后代，或者是一些势微的长老们？
他对于这种炼气境的人，属实看不上，若不执法堂一队队长的身份，这种人，连被他记住的资格都没有。
“他什么意思，敢动我葛颜的人？还判死罪，他好大的官威！”葛颜眉头一皱。
在场的人，都是因为身份，所以知道曹立这个人，但对于这种连筑基境都不是的人，维持点尊重，已经给脸了。
就像是王朝，那些皇亲国戚，可会给锦衣卫一点面子？
有内门弟子说道：“葛师兄，那个曹立太过分了，不教训一下，不足以正你亲传的威名。”
“连葛师兄的人都敢动，这个曹立当了个执法队队长，就把自己当根葱了吧？”
“葛师兄刚好练成了御剑术，此番就拿这曹立试试水。”
葛颜皱眉，看着那个建议的内门弟子：“胡闹，他毕竟还是执法堂的一队队长，身份在那里，要是被我失手打死了，我定难逃执法堂堂主的责罚。”
“这种又菜又爱玩的，真是让人头疼。”
“难不成就看他打了葛师兄的人，无动于衷，这气我忍不下去。”
葛颜回答：“自然是不可能的，招惹我葛颜的人，怎么可能让他全身而退，那我在凌阳宗还怎么混？”
说完，葛颜看着跪在地上的外门弟子吉飞：“你去执法堂一趟，就说，让他放了我表弟，然后亲自来找我赔罪，我可以既往不咎。”
“葛师兄还是太善良了啊。”一群亲传纷纷皱眉，比着大拇指。
跪在地上的外门弟子吉飞连忙喊道：“葛亲传，要是由我去传话，怕是杨大人他已经被处决了。”
“他敢？”葛颜眉毛一挑。

“曹立这次是动真格的，在外门山的时候，杨大人何尝没有搬出葛亲传您的名号，可是曹立无动于衷，一意孤行，差点当场将杨大人斩杀当场，这次，除非葛亲传亲自走一趟，要不然断不可能救下杨大人。”
“当真？”葛颜声线压低。
“他曹立好大的胆子。”
“走，葛师兄，我们陪你一起去看看。”
“走。”
葛颜低语一声：“看来我许久未出手，连小小炼气境，都不把我放在眼里了？”
炼气九层，也就是他一只手就能捏死的修为。
葛颜提着长剑，直接御空飞行，而后面那几个内门弟子，也是御空飞行跟了上去。
执法堂一队队长，算什么东西，放在王朝，就相当于锦衣卫千户，惹了皇族子弟，身份就不对等。
绿衣外门弟子吉飞，也从地上爬了起来，跑步跟随。
……
执法堂，醒了酒的二队队长费安，立马听说了曹立，将昨天调戏了他相好的杨开彬给抓了，这会儿，已经押完行刑司执行死刑了。
而且，执法司长老殉职，曹立接替执法司长老一职，他费安，也从二队队长，变成了一队队长。
“小虎，今年什么年？”费安有点怀疑自己一梦千年。
这才喝醉一次酒，醒来怎么感觉整个世界都变了。
“费队，你就别怀疑了，今年，还是凌阳历四千三百四十七年癸卯……”
小虎接着说道：“戊寅月甲寅日午时。”
一队队长费安揉了揉脑袋，那这么说，世界并没有变过。
content_en:
Ge Yan frowned.
Cao Li personally led the team?
He still knew this person, but he was just the captain of the law enforcement team and was not worthy of being compared with him.
If this kind of person appears in his circle, he is usually the one sitting in the corner.
In my own circle, who is not the descendant of the elders, the descendants of the mountain owner, or some weak elders?
He really looked down upon people in the Qi Refining Realm. Without his status as the captain of the first team of the Law Enforcement Hall, such a person would not even be qualified to be remembered by him.
"What does he mean? He dares to touch my Ge Yan people? He is also sentenced to death. He has such great authority!" Ge Yan frowned.
Everyone present knew Cao Li because of his status, but for someone like this who was not even at the Foundation Establishment level, it would be a shame to maintain some respect.
Just like a dynasty, can those royal relatives give Jin Yiwei some face?
An inner disciple said: "Senior Brother Ge, that Cao Li has gone too far. If you don't teach him a lesson, it won't be enough to correct your reputation."
"You even dare to touch Senior Brother Ge's people. Now that Cao Li has become the captain of the law enforcement team, he has treated himself like a green onion, right?"
"Senior Brother Ge just happened to have mastered the art of sword control. This time I will test the waters with Cao Li."
Ge Yan frowned and looked at the inner disciple who suggested: "Nonsense, after all, he is still the captain of the first team of the Law Enforcement Hall, and his identity is there. If I accidentally beat him to death, I will definitely not be able to escape the punishment of the head of the Law Enforcement Hall."
"This kind of dishonest and fun-loving person is really a headache."
"Is it possible that the person who saw him beating Senior Brother Ge was indifferent? I can't bear this anger."
Ge Yan replied: "Of course it's impossible. How can the person who provokes me, Ge Yan, escape unharmed? How can I still hang out in Lingyang Sect?"
After saying that, Ge Yan looked at the outer disciple Ji Fei who was kneeling on the ground: "Go to the Law Enforcement Hall and tell him to let my cousin go, and then come to me in person to apologize. I can forget about it."
"Senior Brother Ge is still too kind." A group of disciples frowned and gestured with their thumbs.
Ji Fei, an outer disciple who was kneeling on the ground, quickly shouted: "Ge Zhenzhuan, if I were to deliver the message, I'm afraid Master Yang would have been executed."
"He dares?" Ge Yan raised his eyebrows.
"Cao Li is serious this time. When we were at Waimen Mountain, Mr. Yang didn't bring up Ge Qinzhuan's name for you. However, Cao Li was indifferent and insisted on his own way. He almost killed Mr. Yang on the spot. This time, unless Ge Qinzhuan went there in person, it would be impossible to save Mr. Yang."
"Seriously?" Ge Yan lowered his voice.
"He Cao Li is so brave."
"Let's go, Senior Brother Ge, let's go take a look with you."
"Let's go."
Ge Yan whispered: "It seems that I haven't made a move for a long time, and even the small Qi Refining Realm doesn't take me seriously?"
At the ninth level of Qi refining, he was able to crush someone to death with one hand.
Ge Yan held the long sword and flew directly in the air, and the inner disciples behind him also followed in the air.
The captain of the first team of the Law Enforcement Hall is nothing. In the dynasty, he is equivalent to thousands of royal guards. If he offends the royal family's children, his status will be unequal.
Ji Fei, an outer disciple in green clothes, also got up from the ground and ran to follow.
…
At the Law Enforcement Hall, Captain Fei An of the second team sobered up. He immediately heard about Cao Li and arrested Yang Kaibin, who had molested his sweetheart yesterday. At this time, the execution department had finished escorting him to the execution.
Moreover, the elder of the Law Enforcement Department died in the line of duty, and Cao Li took over as the elder of the Law Enforcement Department. Fei An also changed from the captain of the second team to the captain of the first team.
"Xiaohu, what year is this?" Fei An was a little doubtful of his thousand-year dream.
I just got drunk once, and when I woke up, I felt like the whole world had changed.
"Captain Fei, don't doubt it. This year is still the 4347th year of the Lunar Calendar, Guimao..."
Xiaohu then said: "Wuyin month, Jiayin day at noon."
The captain of the first team, Fei An, rubbed itRub your head, so to speak, the world has not changed.
